intervals.label: collaboration: data taking (runs R97 to R01)
intervals.note: Annual 3-4 month runs 1997-2001 at the AGS (24 GeV/c protons from the AGS produce the muon beam).
intervals.quote: obtained in typically 3-4 month annual runs through 2001. In this paper, we indicate the running periods by the labels R97 - R01.

intervals.label: collaboration: completed
intervals.note: End of data taking is taken as the last run label (R01); the storage ring was moved to Fermilab in 2013 for the successor experiment.
intervals.quote: Many people have made important contributions towards the success of E821 over the past twenty years when this experiment was proposed, built and completed.

summary.plain: The international team that ran the Brookhaven muon g-2 experiment E821.
summary.technical: The Muon (g-2) Collaboration that authored the E821 final report (arXiv:hep-ex/0602035).
